plan.notes: Source: official Montclair State University 2026-2027 Undergraduate Catalog, Computer Science (B.S.) program page — Recommended Roadmap to Program of Study Completion (http://catalog.montclair.edu/programs/computer-science-bs/), transcribed manually 2026-09-30 from the catalog page text; catalog year confirmed 2026-2027 on the catalog homepage (http://catalog.montclair.edu/). True degree name: Computer Science (B.S.), Bachelor of Science. 120 credits = the catalog's published baccalaureate minimum ('120 credits of coursework is required for the baccalaureate degree'). Printed roadmap term totals: 14+16+16+16+15+15+15+13 = 120, matching the degree minimum. HONEST DISCREPANCY: the Major Requirements list an 8-credit collateral sequence (PHYS 191 & 192, or CHEM 120 & 121, or BIOL 112 & 113), but the printed roadmap places only ONE 4-credit 'Collateral Sequence course' (Fall, Year 2) and no second half; the same single-course presentation appears in archived crawls of this page, so it is a catalog presentation quirk, not a transcription error. Students must complete the second 4 credits of their chosen collateral sequence with an advisor; the printed roadmap does not place them. Progression gates from the program page (not placed in the roadmap): CSIT 104, CSIT 111, and MATH 111 or MATH 122 or AMAT 120 must be completed with a C- or higher by the end of the student's second semester in the major; students must maintain a minimum 2.60 cumulative GPA during their first three semesters (retention policy); 3.00 overall GPA required. Prereq fields left empty: per-course prerequisites were not published on the roadmap page and are never invented here. Course titles are the catalog's own (e.g., CSIT 315 'Principles of Software Design', CSIT 415 'Software Reliability, Verification and Validation'). The roadmap assumes no prerequisite coursework is required; additional requirements may apply. Major elective and free elective slots use distinct placeholder codes; the two Major Elective slots must be different courses.
